data.one_liner: Standalone library for converting between raw bytes and human-readable file sizes in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Converts byte values into human-readable strings like '1.2 KB' or '3.5 MB', and parses those strings back into numeric byte values. It supports both binary (KiB, MiB) and metric (KB, MB) units with customizable precision and format types.
use_when: You need to display file sizes in a user interface
You are handling file uploads or downloads requiring formatted sizes
You need to parse human-readable storage sizes into raw bytes
avoid_when: You are performing complex file system traversal or IO operations
strengths: Supports both metric and binary units
Handles both parsing and formatting of file sizes
Configurable decimal precision and long/short format types
weaknesses: Limited to file size formatting and conversion only
